title: Implement Request Body Parsing for JSON and URL-Encoded Data
description: This feature is crucial for handling JSON and URL-encoded data in request bodies, enabling yantraverse to support a wider range of API use cases and improving its overall versatility. It will provide automatic parsing of JSON and URL-encoded data, making it easier for developers to handle complex requests. This feature will also include error handling for invalid JSON and malformed requests
testCases: Test JSON parsing with valid data
Test URL-encoded parsing with valid data
Test error handling for invalid JSON
Test error handling for malformed requests
acceptance: The feature is considered complete when request bodies are correctly parsed for JSON and URL-encoded data, and error handling is properly implemented for invalid or malformed requests
reason: This feature is essential for supporting common API use cases and improving the framework's overall usability and reliability
